plugins.name: OC2CPA (OpenCode free models)
plugins.description: OpenCode Zen free models as a CLIProxyAPI plugin provider. Go c-shared port of the original Node.js oc2api server: OpenAI chat-completions in/out, injects the reserved 'read' gate tool the free tier requires, aliases client tool names into oc2cpa_* and restores them in responses, reuses upstream sessions, aggregates the stream-only upstream into a non-streaming payload, keeps watchdog timeouts and real upstream error semantics (only true rate limits are 429).
plugins.author: dingguotu
